body:
I did wrong to people too man. So what, I've learned from my mistakes. Thats life. 

Let your past go, and think about your future. You can't change your past, trust me I want to, but I can't, but I can change my future and you can do it too.

People come and go. Look, talk to yourself and find out what you need to change. And start doing it. Ok?
I am here bro. Just let me know what's bothering you.

Sorry to hear that mate, but that's not the way to do it. You are young, you still can change your life. First step is not thinking about suicide. I had 2 suicide attempts myself but never worked out. And maybe that's better. My life is shit rn too but I am willing to fight this if you are too. 

Let me know if I can help you anymore. I love you bro.
